### Total count and relative abundance plots

```{r rarefaction-genus, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hold', echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
mg_un_curto <- subset_taxa(mg, genus == "Curtobacterium")

curto_counts <- as.data.frame(sort(sample_sums(mg_un_curto), decreasing = T))
colnames(curto_counts)[1] <- "count"
curto_counts$sampleID <- row.names(curto_counts)

genus_data <- read.table(here::here("GTDB_genus_abundance_table.tsv"),
                         header = TRUE, sep = '\t')
colnames(genus_data) <- sub("X", "", colnames(genus_data))
colnames(genus_data) <- gsub("\\.", "", colnames(genus_data))
missing_samples_genus_otus <- setdiff(sam_data$SampleID, colnames(genus_data[, -1]))

genus_count_table <- otu_table(genus_data |> column_to_rownames("genus"), taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
mg_g <- phyloseq(genus_count_table, sam_data)
sort(sample_sums(mg_g))

total_counts <- sample_sums(mg_g) |>
  enframe() |>
  dplyr::rename(sample = name, count = value)

min(sample_sums(mg_g))

rar_table_g <- cached(here::here("cache/rar_table_g.rds"), {
  data.frame(t(rrarefy.perm(data.frame(t(mg_g@otu_table)),
                             sample = 98958, n = 100, round.out = T)))
})
rar_table_g <- rar_table_g[rowSums(rar_table_g) != 0, ]
colnames(rar_table_g) <- sub("X", "", colnames(rar_table_g))
rownames(rar_table_g) <- gsub("\\.", "-", rownames(rar_table_g))
mg_g_rar <- phyloseq(sample_data(mg_g@sam_data),
                     otu_table(as.matrix(rar_table_g), taxa_are_rows = T))
mg_g_rar

# Merge paired samples
mg_g_sd <- data.frame(sample_data(mg_g)) |>
  mutate(merging_id = case_when(
    grepl("3$", SampleID) ~ sub("3$", "1", SampleID),
    grepl("4$", SampleID) ~ sub("4$", "2", SampleID),
    TRUE ~ SampleID
  ))
sample_data(mg_g) <- sample_data(mg_g_sd)
mg_g_mer <- merge_samples(mg_g, group = "merging_id", fun = mean)
cat("Samples after merging:", nsamples(mg_g_mer), "\n")

# Transform to relative abundance and get top 5 genera
mg_g_mer_RA <- transform_sample_counts(mg_g_mer, function(x) x / sum(x))

top5_genera <- psmelt(mg_g_mer_RA) |>
  group_by(OTU) |>
  summarise(mean_RA = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(mean_RA)) |>
  slice_head(n = 5)
top5_genera
top5_genera |> dplyr::select(mean_RA) |> deframe() |> sum()

mg_g_rar_RA_curto <- psmelt(mg_g_mer_RA) |>
  filter(OTU == "Curtobacterium") |>
  dplyr::select(-SampleID) |>
  rename(SampleID = Sample) |>
  (\(df) {
    na_cols <- names(df)[sapply(df, anyNA)]
    left_join(df,
              metadata |> dplyr::select(SampleID, any_of(na_cols)),
              by = "SampleID", suffix = c("_drop", "")) |>
      dplyr::select(-ends_with("_drop"))
  })()

mg_g_rar_RA_curto |>
  group_by(reserve_code) |>
  summarise(mean_RA = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(mean_RA)) |>
  print(n = 24)

metadata$sampleID <- row.names(metadata)
count_summary <- mg_g_rar_RA_curto

# Relative abundance plots
curto_total.ra_plot <- ggplot(count_summary, aes(reorder(sampleID, Abundance, decreasing = T), Abundance)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(title = "Relative abundances of Curtobacterium sequences in each metagenomic library",
       x = "Sample", y = "Curto rel. abundance") +
  apatheme +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 20),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 90, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12))

curto_RA_boxplot <- ggplot(data = count_summary, aes(x = Litter_type, y = Abundance, fill = Litter_type)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge()) +
  facet_grid(~Ecosystem, scale = "free", space = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors, name = "Litter type") +
  xlab("Litter type") + ylab("Relative abundance") +
  ggtitle("Relative abundance of Curtobacterium in Leaf litter") +
  apatheme +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 17), panel.spacing = unit(0, "line"),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "gray", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.1),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
print(curto_RA_boxplot)

# ANOVA
RA_anova <- car::Anova(aov(Abundance ~ Plant_type, data = count_summary), type = "III")
RA_anova
tukey_plantTypeVSlitter <- TukeyHSD(aov(Abundance ~ Plant_type, data = count_summary))
cld <- multcompView::multcompLetters(tukey_plantTypeVSlitter$Plant_type[, "p adj"])
RA_anova_2 <- car::Anova(aov(Abundance ~ Ecosystem * Litter_type, data = count_summary), type = "III")
RA_anova_2

curto_RA_EcosysPT <- ggplot(data = count_summary, aes(x = Plant_type, y = Abundance, fill = Plant_type)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors, name = "Litter type") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 100)) +
  xlab("Litter type") + ylab("Relative abundance") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = ggplot2::margin(t = -50)),
        panel.spacing = unit(0, "line"),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "gray", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.1),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
print(curto_RA_EcosysPT)

ggarrange(litter_chem_comp_barplot, curto_RA_EcosysPT, nrow = 1, widths = c(0.5, 1), labels = "AUTO")
ggsave(filename = here::here("plots/taxa_barplots/RelAb_by_litter_barplot_litterChem.png"),
       width = 220, height = 120, units = "mm", dpi = 300)

# Curtobacterium RA vs environmental variables
for (variable in colnames(count_summary)[c(7:26, 37:41)]) {
  curto_ab_VS_vars_plot <- ggplot(data = count_summary, aes(x = !!sym(variable), y = Abundance)) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
    stat_regline_equation(
      aes(label = paste(..adj.rr.label.., sep = "~~~~")),
      position = "jitter", label.y = Inf) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 100)) +
    geom_point(size = 4) +
    labs(y = "Curtobacterium Relative Abundance") +
    apatheme + theme(text = element_text(size = 16))
  print(curto_ab_VS_vars_plot)
  ggsave(filename = paste(here::here("plots/linear_regression/total_curto_Ab_vs"),
                          variable, "png", sep = "."),
         width = 30, height = 20, units = "cm", dpi = 320)
}

mean(count_summary$Abundance) * 100
count_summary |> ungroup() |> group_by(reserve_code) |>
  reframe(meanRA = mean(Abundance, na.rm = T) * 100) |>
  dplyr::arrange(meanRA) |> print(n = 24)

```

#### Partial Dependence Plots with Total Curto Relative Abundance

```{r PDPs, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hold', echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# Partial dependence plots with total Curto relative abundance
set.seed(711)

pcadf_expanded <- pcadf |>
  dplyr::select(PC1, PC2, SampleID) |>
  dplyr::mutate(SiteID = substr(SampleID, 1, 2)) |>
  group_by(SiteID) %>%
  summarise(SampleID = c(paste0(SiteID, "D1"), paste0(SiteID, "D2"),
                         paste0(SiteID, "G1"), paste0(SiteID, "G2"))) %>%
  left_join(pcadf |> dplyr::select(PC1, PC2, SampleID), by = "SampleID") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(SiteID = substr(SampleID, 1, 2)) |>
  group_by(SiteID) %>%
  mutate(
    PC1 = case_when(
      is.na(PC1) & grepl("D", SampleID) ~ coalesce(first(PC1[grepl("D1", SampleID)]), first(PC1[grepl("G1", SampleID)])),
      is.na(PC1) & grepl("G", SampleID) ~ coalesce(first(PC1[grepl("G1", SampleID)]), first(PC1[grepl("D1", SampleID)])),
      TRUE ~ PC1),
    PC2 = case_when(
      is.na(PC2) & grepl("D", SampleID) ~ coalesce(first(PC2[grepl("D1", SampleID)]), first(PC2[grepl("G1", SampleID)])),
      is.na(PC2) & grepl("G", SampleID) ~ coalesce(first(PC2[grepl("G1", SampleID)]), first(PC2[grepl("D1", SampleID)])),
      TRUE ~ PC2)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(SiteID, SampleID) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(!SampleID %in% c("19D1", "19D2"))

count_summary <- count_summary %>%
  dplyr::select(-any_of(c("PC1.clim", "PC2.clim", "PC1.litt", "PC2.litt"))) %>%
  merge(., pcadf_expanded |> dplyr::select(-SiteID), by.x = "SampleID", by.y = "SampleID") %>%
  dplyr::rename(PC1.clim = PC1, PC2.clim = PC2) %>%
  merge(., pca_litt_df_md %>% dplyr::select(Row.names, PC1, PC2), by.x = "SampleID", by.y = "Row.names") %>%
  dplyr::rename(PC1.litt = PC1, PC2.litt = PC2)

clim_vars_PC   <- c("PC1.clim", "PC2.clim")
litter_vars    <- c("pH", "crude_protein", "cellulose", "hemicellulose", "lignin")
litter_vars_PC <- c("PC1.litt", "PC2.litt")

colnames(count_summary) <- gsub(" ", ".", colnames(count_summary))


# Exploratory PDP (iml / simple RF)
pdp_temp <- count_summary %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(SampleID, reserve_code, Litter_type)) %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of("Abundance"), dplyr::all_of(c(clim_vars_PC, litter_vars))) %>%
  na.omit() |>
  dplyr::rename(curto_ra = Abundance)

rf.mod  <- randomForest(curto_ra ~ ., data = pdp_temp)
glm.mod <- glm(curto_ra ~ ., data = pdp_temp)
X       <- pdp_temp[!(names(pdp_temp) %in% "curto_ra")]
predictor_rf  <- Predictor$new(model = rf.mod,  data = X, y = pdp_temp$curto_ra)
predictor_glm <- Predictor$new(glm.mod, data = X, y = pdp_temp$curto_ra)
imp_rf        <- iml::FeatureImp$new(predictor_rf,  loss = "rmse", n.repetitions = 100, compare = "difference")
imp_glm       <- FeatureImp$new(predictor_glm, loss = "rmse", n.repetitions = 100, compare = "difference")
imp_results_rf  <- imp_rf$results
imp_results_glm <- imp_glm$results
effs_rf  <- FeatureEffects$new(predictor_rf,  grid.size = 20, method = "pdp")
effs_glm <- FeatureEffects$new(predictor_glm, grid.size = 20, method = "pdp")
effs_results_rf  <- do.call(rbind, effs_rf$results)
effs_results_glm <- do.call(rbind, effs_glm$results)
rug <- X

pdp_plot_rf <- effs_results_rf %>%
  mutate(var_type = case_when(.feature %in% clim_vars_PC ~ "Climate",
                              .feature %in% litter_vars  ~ "Litter chemistry", TRUE ~ NA),
         .feature = dplyr::recode(.feature, PC1.clim = "PC1", PC2.clim = "PC2")) |>
  dplyr::filter(.type == "pdp") %>%
  mutate(.feature = gsub("_", " ", .feature)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = .borders, y = .value, color = .feature)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = allvars_pallete) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 100)) +
  geom_rug(data = reshape2::melt(rug) |> dplyr::rename(.feature = variable) |>
             mutate(.feature = dplyr::recode(.feature, PC1.clim = "PC1", PC2.clim = "PC2"),
                    .feature = gsub("_", " ", .feature)),
           aes(x = value), sides = "b", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  ggh4x::facet_nested(~ var_type + .feature, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(x = "Variable value",
       y = "Predicted relative abundance\n(# Curtobacterium reads/# total prokaryotic reads)") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  guides(color = "none") +
  apatheme +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8, margin = ggplot2::margin(r = 10)),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "black"),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey90"),
        text = element_text(size = 10))
print(pdp_plot_rf)

ggsave(filename = here::here("plots/plots_pdp/pdp_plot_glm_totalCurtoRA_clim_litt_vars.png"),
       width = 60, height = 40, units = "cm", dpi = 320)

# Bootstrapped RF analysis with CIs
curto_ra_res <- cached(here::here("cache/curto_ra_res.rds"), {
  run_rf_analysis(
    df           = count_summary,
    response_var = "Abundance",
    predictors   = c(clim_vars_PC, litter_vars),
    ntree        = 1000, cv_folds = 10, nperm_oob = 500,
    nrep_vi = 500, n_boot = 100, grid.size = 20)
})

curto_ra_res$summary_table

write.table(curto_ra_res$summary_table,
            file = here::here("plots/RF_validation_curto_RA.csv"),
            quote = F, row.names = F, col.names = T, sep = ",")

plots_rf_ra <- generate_plots(
  imp_results_rf = curto_ra_res$imp_results_rf,
  pdp_ci_df      = curto_ra_res$pdp_ci_df,
  rug            = curto_ra_res$rug,
  clim_vars_PC, litter_vars, allvars_pallete, apatheme,
  cv_r2          = curto_ra_res$CV_r2,
  curto_ra_res$pval_cv,
  sig_vars       = curto_ra_res$sig_vars_rfp,
  response_label = "Relative abundance")
plots_rf_ra

curto_RA_PDP_plot <- ggarrange(plots_rf_ra$pdp_plot_rf, plots_rf_ra$imp_plot_pdp_rf,
                               labels = "AUTO", ncol = 2, common.legend = F,
                               widths = c(1.75, 0.65), hjust = -0.2)
print(curto_RA_PDP_plot)

ggsave(filename = here::here("plots/plots_pdp/pdp_plot_rf_totalCurtoRA_clim_litt_vars_Sig_varsCIs.png"),
       plot = curto_RA_PDP_plot, width = 250, height = 100, units = "mm",
       dpi = 300, device = "png", type = "cairo-png")
```

#### Rarefaction of Count table

```{r rarefaction-strain, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hold', echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
mg <- prune_samples(sample_sums(mg) != 0, mg)

mgB4rar   <- subset_taxa(mg, genus == "Curtobacterium")
rar_table <- cached(here::here("cache/rar_table.rds"), {
  data.frame(t(rrarefy.perm(data.frame(t(mgB4rar@otu_table)),
                             sample = 1945, n = 100, round.out = T)))
})
rar_table <- rar_table[rowSums(rar_table) != 0, ]
colnames(rar_table) <- sub("X", "", colnames(rar_table))
rownames(rar_table) <- sub("X", "", rownames(rar_table))
rownames(rar_table) <- gsub("\\.", "-", rownames(rar_table))
mg_rar <- phyloseq(sample_data(mg@sam_data),
                   otu_table(as.matrix(rar_table), taxa_are_rows = T),
                   tax_table(mg@tax_table))
saveRDS(mgB4rar, here::here("results/rds/mgB4rar.rds"))
saveRDS(mg_rar, here::here("results/rds/mg_rar.rds"))
mg_rar
```

### Relative abundance plots (taxa barplots)

```{r taxa-barplots, echo=FALSE, fig.height=14, fig.width=30, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hold'}
genus_bp_df <- tax_glom(mg, taxrank = "genus") %>%
  transform_sample_counts(., function(x) {x / sum(x)}) %>%
  psmelt() %>%
  arrange(genus)

barplot_genus_g <- ggplot(genus_bp_df %>% filter(Litter_type == "G"),
                          aes(x = Sample, y = Abundance, fill = genus)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") + scale_fill_manual(values = colors) + theme_bw() +
  facet_grid(~ reserve_code, scale = "free", space = "free_x") +
  xlab("Litter Samples") + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) + ylab("Abundance (%)") +
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = NULL) + labs(fill = "Genus") +
  ggtitle("Abundant genera in Grass Leaf litter") +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 17), panel.spacing = unit(0, "line"),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "gray", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.1),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank())

barplot_genus_d <- ggplot(genus_bp_df %>% filter(Litter_type == "DV"),
                          aes(x = Sample, y = Abundance, fill = genus)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") + scale_fill_manual(values = colors) + theme_bw() +
  facet_grid(~ reserve_code, scale = "free", space = "free_x") +
  xlab("Litter Samples") + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) + ylab("Abundance (%)") +
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = NULL) + labs(fill = "Genus") +
  ggtitle("Abundant genera in Dominant Vegetation litter") +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 17), panel.spacing = unit(0, "line"),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "gray", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.1),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank())

ggarrange(barplot_genus_g, barplot_genus_d, ncol = 1, labels = "AUTO", common.legend = T, legend = "bottom")
ggsave(here::here("plots/taxa_barplots/taxabp_genus.png"),
       width = 45, height = 40, units = "cm", dpi = 320)

clades_bp_df <- tax_glom(mg, taxrank = "clade") %>%
  transform_sample_counts(., function(x) {x / sum(x)}) %>%
  psmelt() %>%
  mutate(clade = factor(clade, levels = c("I", "II", "III", "IV", "V", "UND"))) %>%
  arrange(clade)

barplot_clades_g <- ggplot(clades_bp_df %>% filter(Litter_type == "G"),
                           aes(x = Sample, y = Abundance, fill = clade)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") + scale_fill_manual(values = clade_colors) + theme_bw() +
  facet_grid(~ reserve_code, scale = "free", space = "free_x") + xlab("Litter Samples") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) + ylab("Abundance (%)") +
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = NULL) + labs(fill = "Clade") +
  ggtitle("Curtobacterium clades in Grass litter") +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 17), panel.spacing = unit(0, "line"),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "gray", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.1),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank())

barplot_clades_d <- ggplot(clades_bp_df %>% filter(Litter_type == "DV"),
                           aes(x = Sample, y = Abundance, fill = clade)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") + scale_fill_manual(values = clade_colors) + theme_bw() +
  facet_grid(~ reserve_code, scale = "free", space = "free_x") + xlab("Litter Samples") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) + ylab("Abundance (%)") +
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = NULL) + labs(fill = "Clade") +
  ggtitle("Curtobacterium clades in Dominant Vegetation litter") +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 17), panel.spacing = unit(0, "line"),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "gray", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.1),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank())

ggarrange(barplot_clades_g, barplot_clades_d, ncol = 1, labels = "AUTO", common.legend = T, legend = "bottom")
ggsave(here::here("plots/taxa_barplots/taxabp_clades.png"),
       width = 45, height = 40, units = "cm", dpi = 320)

clades_bp_df |> group_by(clade) |> summarise(meanRA = mean(Abundance) * 100)

#### get top 25 strains ####
top25names <- names(sort(taxa_sums(mg_rar), decreasing = T)[1:100])
top25 <- as.data.frame(tax) |>
  dplyr::filter(row.names(tax) %in% top25names) |>
  rownames_to_column("rowname") %>%
  mutate(rowname = factor(rowname, levels = top25names)) %>%
  arrange(rowname) %>%
  column_to_rownames("rowname") |>
  dplyr::mutate(total_abundance = sort(taxa_sums(mg_rar), decreasing = T)[1:100])

base::table(top25$clade)
base::table(top25$subclade)

subclade_colors_bp <- c(
  "Clade I" = "transparent",   "IA" = subclade_colros[["IA"]],   "IB" = subclade_colros[["IB"]],   "IC" = subclade_colros[["IC"]],
  "Clade II" = "transparent",  "IIA" = subclade_colros[["IIA"]], "IIB" = subclade_colros[["IIB"]], "IIC" = subclade_colros[["IIC"]],
  "IID" = subclade_colros[["IID"]], "IIE" = subclade_colros[["IIE"]], "IIF" = subclade_colros[["IIF"]], "IIG" = subclade_colros[["IIG"]],
  "IIH" = subclade_colros[["IIH"]], "IIJ" = subclade_colros[["IIJ"]], "IIK" = subclade_colros[["IIK"]],
  "Clade III" = "transparent", "IIIA" = subclade_colros[["IIIA"]], "IIIB" = subclade_colros[["IIIB"]],
  "IIIC" = subclade_colros[["IIIC"]], "IIID" = subclade_colros[["IIID"]], "IIIE" = subclade_colros[["IIIE"]], "IIIF" = subclade_colros[["IIIF"]],
  "Clade IV" = "transparent",  "IVA" = subclade_colros[["IVA"]], "IVB" = subclade_colros[["IVB"]],
  "IVC" = subclade_colros[["IVC"]], "IVD" = subclade_colros[["IVD"]], "IVE" = subclade_colros[["IVE"]],
  "Clade V" = "transparent",   "VA" = subclade_colros[["VA"]]
)

subclades_one_sample_per_LitterTrype_df <- tax_glom(mg_rar, taxrank = "subclade") %>%
  merge_samples("reserve_litter")

otu_matrix   <- as.matrix(t(otu_table(subclades_one_sample_per_LitterTrype_df)))
otu_averaged <- apply(otu_matrix, 2, function(x) round(x / 2))
otu_averaged <- otu_averaged[, colnames(otu_matrix)]
otu_table(subclades_one_sample_per_LitterTrype_df) <- otu_table(otu_averaged, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)

oneSample_LitterType_sam_data <- data.frame(subclades_one_sample_per_LitterTrype_df@sam_data) |>
  dplyr::select(-c(reserve_litter, reserve_code, Litter_type)) |>
  rownames_to_column("reserve_litter") |>
  left_join(metadata |>
              mutate(reserve_litter = paste(reserve_code, Litter_type, sep = "-")) |>
              dplyr::select(reserve_litter, reserve_code, Litter_type) |>
              distinct(reserve_litter, .keep_all = T), by = "reserve_litter") |>
  column_to_rownames("reserve_litter")
sample_data(subclades_one_sample_per_LitterTrype_df) <- oneSample_LitterType_sam_data

subclades_bp_df <- subclades_one_sample_per_LitterTrype_df <- 
  transform_sample_counts(subclades_one_sample_per_LitterTrype_df, function(x) {x / sum(x)}) %>%
  psmelt() %>%
  mutate(subclade = factor(subclade, levels = subclds)) %>%
  arrange(subclade)

correct_order <- c(
  "Clade I", "IA", "IB", "IC",
  "Clade II", "IIA", "IIB", "IIC", "IID", "IIE", "IIF", "IIG", "IIH", "IIJ", "IIK",
  "Clade III", "IIIA", "IIIB", "IIIC", "IIID", "IIIE", "IIIF",
  "Clade IV", "IVA", "IVB", "IVC", "IVD", "IVE",
  "Clade V", "VA"
)

dummy_clades <- data.frame(
  Sample      = c(rep("SCPS-G", 5), rep("MER-D", 5)),
  reserve_code = c(rep("SCPS", 5), rep("MER", 5)),
  Abundance   = 0.0000000001,
  subclade    = factor(rep(c("Clade I", "Clade II", "Clade III", "Clade IV", "Clade V"), 2),
                       levels = names(subclade_colors_bp)),
  Litter_type = c(rep("G", 5), rep("DV", 5))
)

subclades_one_sample_per_LitterTrype_df <- bind_rows(subclades_one_sample_per_LitterTrype_df, dummy_clades)

subcladeIIIA_sorted_df <- subclades_one_sample_per_LitterTrype_df |>
  dplyr::filter(subclade == "IIIA" & Litter_type == "G") |>
  arrange(Abundance) |>
  mutate(reserve_code = fct_reorder(reserve_code, Abundance))

subclades_one_sample_per_LitterTrype_df$subclade <-
  factor(subclades_one_sample_per_LitterTrype_df$subclade, levels = correct_order)

barplot_subclades_g <- ggplot(
  subclades_one_sample_per_LitterTrype_df %>%
    filter(Litter_type == "G") |>
    mutate(reserve_code = factor(reserve_code, levels = levels(subcladeIIIA_sorted_df$reserve_code))),
  aes(x = Sample, y = Abundance, fill = subclade)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = subclade_colors_bp, labels = correct_order) +
  theme_bw() + facet_grid(~ reserve_code, scale = "free", space = "free_x") +
  xlab("") + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) + ylab("Abundance (%)") +
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = NULL) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1, override.aes = list(size = 4))) +
  labs(fill = "Subclade") + ggtitle("Grass litter") +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 10), panel.spacing = unit(0, "line"),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "gray", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.1),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "right",
        legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"), legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12), legend.spacing.y = unit(0.1, "cm"),
        legend.margin = ggplot2::margin(2, 2, 2, 2))
print(barplot_subclades_g)

barplot_subclades_d <- ggplot(
  subclades_one_sample_per_LitterTrype_df %>%
    filter(Litter_type == "DV") |>
    mutate(reserve_code = factor(reserve_code, levels = levels(subcladeIIIA_sorted_df$reserve_code))),
  aes(x = Sample, y = Abundance, fill = subclade)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = subclade_colors_bp) +
  theme_bw() + facet_grid(~ reserve_code, scale = "free", space = "free_x") +
  xlab("Litter Samples") + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) + ylab("Abundance (%)") +
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = NULL) + labs(fill = "Subclade") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1, override.aes = list(size = 4))) +
  ggtitle("Dominant Vegetation litter") +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 10), panel.spacing = unit(0, "line"),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "gray", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.1),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank())

ggarrange(barplot_subclades_g, barplot_subclades_d, ncol = 1, labels = "AUTO",
          common.legend = T, legend = "right")
ggsave(here::here("plots/taxa_barplots/taxabp_subclades.png"),
       width = 260, height = 130, units = "mm", dpi = 300)
```
